Q00255_Tutorial/32134-001.htm.text: Newbie Helper: Welcome! I have a mission for you. Do you see the Gremlins all around us? One of them has stolen a precious Blue Gem from me. You must defeat the Gremlins and recover the Blue Gem . To target a Gremlin for attack, simply move your cursor on top of it and click the left mouse button .…

Q00255_Tutorial/30009-006.htm.text: Newbie Helper: I can't teach you. You should find the newbie helper for your occupation.

Q00255_Tutorial/32134-002.htm.text: Newbie Helper: Did you forget your mission? You must defeat the Gremlins and recover the Blue Gem they stole . To target a Gremlin for attack, simply move your cursor on top of it and click the left mouse button . The cursor will change into the shape of a knife; when that happens, click the left m…

Q00255_Tutorial/32134-003.htm.text: Newbie Helper: Ah, you have the Blue Gem! Well done. Here is the gift I promised you. It is called a Soulshot, which can be used to inflict a powerful attack. It can only be used once, though, so use it wisely. Now take this certificate of achievement to Vice Hierarch Perwan , and he will give you …

Q00255_Tutorial/32134-004.htm.text: Newbie Helper: Seek out Vice Hierarch Perwan , and he will give you another useful gift. May fortune pave a path for your feet!

Q00255_Tutorial/32134-005.htm.text: Newbie Helper: I can teach you nothing more. It is time for you to venture out into the world and let the real adventures begin!
